description:
Snow Clouds: How Fluffy Clouds Turn Into Soft Snowflakes! — Rain, rain go away... wait, it's too cold for rain! How do fluffy gray clouds turn water vapor into soft, fluffy white snow?
Kids science answer for "how does snow form for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When the upper atmosphere drops below 32 degrees Fahrenheit, water vapor bypasses liquid form through deposition, directly crystalizing into ice on microscopic pollen or mineral dust particles.
